description: A folder wrapped in parentheses that organizes app/ routes and shared layouts without appearing in the public URL path.
A folder prefixed with an underscore that opts itself and all nested subfolders completely out of Next.js routing.
A bracketed folder name that matches one variable URL segment and passes its string value inside params.
A spread-bracket folder that captures one or more trailing URL segments into an array of strings.
A double-bracket spread folder that matches zero or more trailing URL segments, including the parent route itself.
